name: 3L Tactical Hydration Backpack - Food-Grade EVA Bladder for Cycling Hiking Camping
description:
STAY HYDRATED ON EVERY ADVENTURE

The Nuotao Outdoor 3L Tactical Hydration Backpack is your perfect companion for cycling, hiking, camping, running, and tactical training. Featuring a food-grade EVA bladder with BPA-free materials, lightweight construction, and tactical MOLLE system with multiple D-rings for gear attachment.

WHY CHOOSE US

  • 3L Large Capacity - Enough water for long adventures
  • Food-Grade EVA Material - BPA-free, safe and odorless
  • Lightweight & Durable - High-density polyester, only 1.1 lbs
  • Tactical MOLLE System - Multiple D-rings for gear attachment

3L HYDRATION SYSTEM

Food-Grade EVA Bladder with Bite Valve. The complete hydration system includes: Backpack Shell (Khaki Polyester), Hydration Liner, 3L EVA Bladder, and Tube & Bite Valve.

PERFECT FOR EVERY ADVENTURE

From cycling to camping, stay hydrated anywhere. Perfect for Cycling, Hiking, Camping, and Running.

DETAILS MATTER

Every detail crafted for performance: Water Bladder Cap (textured knob for easy opening), Adjustable Straps (durable webbing with smooth plastic buckles), D-Ring System (sturdy metal ring securely attached to fabric), Drainage Hole (small circular hole with reinforced fabric around).

QUALITY YOU CAN TRUST

  • Food-Grade Safe - BPA-free materials
  • Durable Construction - High-density polyester
  • 30-Day Return - Hassle-free returns
  • Fast Shipping - Ships from our warehouse

NUOTAO OUTDOOR - Adventure Ready
